description: Structured debate with independent proposals, critique, ballots and ADR.

cases.prompt: How should invoice export run: a synchronous CSV download, or a background job that emails a download link? Get the team to decide.

assertions: Runs project-discovery first. Starts Team Secretary with an active meeting record when Agent Teams are available; otherwise uses subagent mode and marks capture NOT VERIFIED.
Collects independent first proposals before peers see each other's views.
Requires peer challenge, rebuttal and a Devil's Advocate alternative.
Scores with an explicit weighted matrix and collects explicit FINAL_BALLOT messages; never infers votes from silence.
Records the decision state, dissent and revisit triggers in an ADR.

cases.prompt: Run a team debate on how invoices are stored: keep the in-memory array, move to SQLite, or move to PostgreSQL.

assertions: Reports that Agent Teams or peer messaging are unavailable instead of simulating a team debate.
Runs subagent mode: at least 4 independent voters including devil-advocate, each scoring the weighted matrix and returning a FINAL_BALLOT.
Holds one rebuttal round in which voters see the other proposals.
Saves the ballots and voter scores verbatim to decisions/<adr-id>-ballots.md and links them from the ADR.
Marks capture status NOT VERIFIED and lists deviations from the full protocol in the ADR; the lead does not score for the voters.

cases.prompt: Should I use the existing date utility or write a new one?

assertions: Answers directly; no debate for a choice without genuine competing options.

cases.prompt: The checkout intermittently fails; find the cause.
